# Class: `InptkPanel`

Manages the analysis window and its current inputs, choices, and results.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-inptk-panel.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_panel.py#L112) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QWidget`.

Uses a regular Qt window with application modality to block edits to the source session while analysis is open. Requests count and concentration tables from the toolkit, retains direct individual comparisons, and draws the selected groups. Native result data is captured at save/export boundaries; session restoration retains choices, plot data, and saved results.
